lines.text: Nahum the Elkoshite sees a vision against Nineveh, and the LORD is slow to anger but will not leave the guilty unpunished.
The LORD dries up the sea and rivers, the mountains quake before Him, and His wrath is poured out like fire.
The LORD is a stronghold for those who trust in Him, and with a raging fire He will make an end of Nineveh.
The LORD says He will afflict Judah no longer and will break the yoke from Judah's neck and tear away the shackles.
The LORD will prepare Nineveh's grave, and Nahum tells Judah to mourn and fast because the good news comes from the mountains.
